title: 🚨 YOUR CAMPUS DOESN’T NEED ANOTHER CHRISTIAN SPECTATOR.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOUR CAMPUS DOESN’T NEED ANOTHER CHRISTIAN SPECTATOR.
It needs someone willing to open a Bible.
Pray.
Gather a few people.
And start making disciples.
You may think you need permission, confidence, theological training, a big following, or 30 committed students before you can begin.
You don’t.
That belief may be exactly what is keeping you from obeying what God has already placed in front of you.
Jesus said:
“Go therefore and make disciples of all nations…” — Matthew 28:19
That includes the campus where God has placed you.
HOW TO START A CHRISTIAN CAMPUS BIBLE STUDY
This isn't just a book about organizing meetings.

It's a practical guide for students and young believers who want to turn ordinary tables, classrooms, dorms, cafeterias, and friendships into opportunities for Scripture, Gospel conversations, Christian community, and discipleship.
Maybe you've thought:
“I don't know enough.”
“What if nobody comes?”
“What if people reject me?”
“I wouldn't know what to teach.”
“What if someone asks a question I can't answer?”
This book was written for you.
🔥 INSIDE, YOU'LL LEARN HOW TO:

• Start your Bible study with prayer and the right biblical foundation
• Find one or two faithful believers to build with
• Invite students naturally without manipulation or pressure
• Lead simple, Scripture-centered discussions
• Keep Jesus and the Gospel at the center
• Handle difficult questions with truth, humility, and grace
• Build genuine Christian community beyond weekly meetings
• Call people toward repentance without creating a culture of condemnation
• Develop students from attendees into disciples
• Train new leaders so the ministry can continue after you graduate
• Share the Gospel confidently on your campus
• Build a Bible study that can eventually multiply into other groups
And here's the challenge:

Most people want revival.
Few want to start with five people around a table.
Most want influence.
Few embrace hidden faithfulness.
Most Christians want their campus changed.
Few are willing to become the person who says:
“I'll start.”
Maybe God isn't asking you to reach everyone tomorrow.
Maybe He's asking you to faithfully reach the person sitting beside you today.
🔥 FOR THOSE WHO WANT TO DO MORE THAN SCROLL.
If you want to grow in Christ…
If you want resources that help you disciple others…
If you want to help put biblical teaching into more hands…
If you want to turn your campus into a mission field…
Don't wait until you feel like a leader.

Pray.
Open the Bible.
Invite someone.
Make disciples.
👇 ENGAGEMENT CHALLENGE

KNOW CHRIST.
STAND IN TRUTH.
MAKE DISCIPLES.
